data.name: Cucumber Airlines
data.detailed_description:
In Cucumber Airlines, your dream job in the clouds takes a weird turn when you realize every single passenger is a sentient, grumpy cucumber. These aren't just snacks; they are loud, they are bouncy, and they have absolutely no respect for the "fasten seatbelt" sign.

As the only flight attendant on board, you are the only thing stopping this plane from turning into a giant jar of pickles. Grab, toss, and shove your passengers into their seats while dealing with mid-air turbulence that sends everything—and everyone—flying.

Key Features:

  • Total Physics Mayhem: Every cucumber is a slippery, bouncy mess. Watch them roll down the aisles, fly through the air, and get stuck in overhead bins while you struggle to keep control.

  • The "Losing It" Meter: Balance your professional cool. As the cabin gets messier, your sanity drops, turning you from a polite host into a bossy drill sergeant who won't take any more veggie nonsense.

  • Dirty Work: It’s not just about the cucumbers. You’ll need to slam shut broken bins, mop up slippery green juice, and keep the exits clear before the pilot gets fed up.

  • The Flight from Hell: Start with easy trips for "chill" cucumbers and work your way up to long-haul nightmares full of massive veggie riots.

Can you survive the trip, or will the job turn you sour? Buckle up—it’s going to be a bumpy ride.

data.short_description: You finally landed your dream job as a flight attendant—too bad your passengers are a bunch of pesky cucumbers. Keep the cabin from crumbling into absolute mayhem, juggle unruly veggies and your sanity to ensure a (mostly) safe landing.
data.supported_languages: English, French, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
